text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Political parties announce their candidates for mayoral races and campaign strategy on the eve of elections.
- U.S. toxicologists to investigate poisoning cases involving children in the Tetovo region. No new cases of poisoning reported in the Tetovo pediatric hospital.
- Passports from all European countries and the United States can be bought at a special market in the Albanian capital Tirana. A Macedonian passport goes for $3,000.

- Bulgaria wants to "adopt" Macedonians from the Mala Prespa region in Albaina and proclaim them as Bulgarians. Bulgarians promise clothing and free education for Macedonians from the Albanian region.
- Macedonian defence minister Blagoja Handziski visits Turkey to see how agreements on military cooperation and education are being implemented.
- Under agreement on duty free customs regime between Macedonia and Yugoslavia, the Yugo car soon to be cheaper cheaper on the Macedonia market.

- "The assimilation of Serbs in Macedonia should stop", participants of a two-day conference in Sremski Karlovci on the position of Serbs in Macedonia concluded. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201196
